scope: Controlled physical grasp/retention assay from selected development checkpoints; NOT a learned-controller comparison or final placement result.
checkpoint_rule: First DESCEND_OBJECT control tick in the last descent segment before the first actual retry closure; initial closure for nominal positive control.
planning_inputs: Recorded learned capsule center/axis, recorded gripper target quaternion, and recorded learned fixture center. No true target pose/contact/axis may select the action.
initialization: Restore complete physical checkpoint once before each counterfactual trial. Object and fixture poses are never rewritten during the action. Keep original masses, friction, collision geometry, actuator limits and IK.
evaluation: Log true rise, contact, clearance, tracking and retention separately. A collision-free retained lift is an assay outcome, never paper-level placement success. Frozen observations intentionally isolate mechanics and do not validate perception continuity or safe stale-observation control.
